messages.subject: Middle East Executive | Corporate Affairs, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Oumama,

Your leadership of Carter Murray's Middle East and Africa practice and senior search work across communications, strategy and commercial leadership makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE where strategy, reputation, stakeholder engagement and institutional relationships are central to execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
